evals.prompt: Add Emailit to my Next.js app to send a welcome email on signup.
evals.expected_output: Installs @emailit/node, reads EMAILIT_API_KEY from env, sends from a configured address, and suggests a background job.
expectations: Does not hardcode an API key
Suggests sending outside the request path

evals.prompt: Configure Laravel to send all mail through Emailit.
evals.expected_output: Installs emailit/emailit-laravel, sets MAIL_MAILER=emailit and EMAILIT_API_KEY, and adds the mailer config.
expectations: Adds the emailit mailer to config/mail.php

evals.prompt: Make my order receipt emails safe to retry.
evals.expected_output: Adds an Idempotency-Key derived from the order ID and retries only 429, network, and 5xx errors.
expectations: Derives the key from a stable business ID
